title: Get a compliance certificate for a new pool
what: Apply for a compliance certificate for a new pool and its barrier at small premises within 7 days of building them, before filling the pool.

sources.title: Swimming Pool Safety Act 2004 (NT)
sources.quote: After the construction at small premises of both a swimming pool and swimming pool barrier, the owner of the premises must apply for a compliance certificate in respect of the swimming pool: (a) within 7 days after completion of construction; and

sources.title: Swimming Pool Safety Act 2004 (NT)
sources.locator: s 18, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current reprint)
sources.quote: The Authority must issue an interim compliance certificate to an applicant if the Authority is satisfied about all the information contained in the application for the certificate.
